ICT Procurement Cycle (step 3): Send this F1 to DP for a call for quotations. Quotes return to ITDIR for tech/spec evaluation; complete the Cost Comparative Schedule (value for money) and attach it with F1 + quotations for AIAD due diligence / certificate; then DP raises an Electronic P/O (against DAF target/budget) or a Manual P/O (requires DAF authorisation if not provisioned) → delivery note → verification → payment.
